Dialogs.Dialog: Oh, it looks like the battery is running low. Shall we charge it？
Take care. Come home early, okay？
Yes. Do your best today too, okay？ Take care！
Oh, wait. A see-you-later kiss... Mm, take care.
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲. How was today？
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲. Thanks for your hard work today▼
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲. A welcome-home kiss▼ Just kidding...
Hehe, enjoy. Take your time eating, okay？
Which tastes better, this or my cooking？ ...Just kidding.
There. Did you clean your plate？ Hehe.
Don't forget to brush your teeth, okay？
Let's clean up properly afterward, okay？
Okay. See you tomorrow？ Good night.
Leaving me behind？ ...Just kidding. Hehe, good night.
Good night. I hope we can meet in my dreams too... Just kidding.
Hey, what are you interested in these days？
Hehe, sounds fun. Maybe I'll get into it too？
I see. Hey, then let's find something we can both enjoy？
Is that so... Tell me more about it next time？
Hey, what kind of music are you listening to lately？
Sometimes it's like that, right？ I think I get it.
Next time, let's show each other our favorite songs？ Promise.
Are there any interesting TV shows these days？
That sounds interesting. Maybe I'll ask to watch it with you？
I see. If you find a show that looks fun, tell me, okay？
Someday I want to watch it side by side. Just kidding.
Hey, what do you think my best feature is？
...Flattering me won't get you anything. Hehe！
Hey, is my hairstyle right now the kind you like？
Eh... Then maybe I'll try a different hairstyle... I see...
Tell me sometime, okay？ I want to always be your type. Just kidding.
Hey, what do you think of the clothes I wear lately？ Like them？
I'm glad to hear that. Hehe.
I see... Mm, I'll try harder, okay？
Maybe next time I'll have you pick out my whole outfit？ Hehe.
Hmm... I wonder if I should do something...
I see. Don't push yourself too hard, okay？
I won't get in the way, so can I watch？ Hehe.
I haven't been able to sleep lately... Maybe it's your fault...
That's right. Geez... you don't hold back at all...
It's not wrong, because... Geez, never mind.
When I think about you, I... I won't be able to sleep tonight either, I bet...
Me too. A lot happened... Geez, don't stare at me.
...Meanie. I won't go with you anymore.
Hey, you don't think I'm... too clingy, do you？
Good. Then I'll keep sticking close to you？ Just kidding.
I see... Maybe I'll hold back a little...
I don't want to be apart, so I just... I want to be by your side forever...
Hey, were you just thinking about me？
I knew it. Our hearts are connected, right？ Hehe！
That's your "trying to fool me" face. Right？ Hehehe！
My mind is full of you, you know？ Always...
Hey, when do you feel happy？
For me, it's when I'm with you. I hope it goes on forever...
Hehe, that's so you. I like that about you too... Just kidding.
Hmm？ For me, I guess it's now. Just having you here makes me so happy.
Hey, hey... I love you. I'm kidding.
Stay by my side from now on too, okay？
This kind of thing is nice, right？ Hehe.
Hey, come here and close your eyes？ *Smooch*. Surprised？ Hehe！
▲主人公＊▲. ...I just wanted to say your name. Hehe！
I want something sweet... Ah, I'm just talking to myself, so don't mind me？ Okay？
...Ah！ Um... did you hear me？ Oh, geez...
Hey, give me your hand？ ...Hehe, it's warm.
It's warm and nice out, right？
I like the smell of spring...
Makes you want to take a lunch to the park, right？
The greenery is getting thicker, right？
I want to eat ice cream▼
I want to go see the autumn leaves.
The sun's been setting earlier, right？
I want to eat some sweet potatoes.
Outside, my breath was all white, you know？
My hands are cold, so I want you to warm them... I'm kidding.
Were you up all night, by any chance？ Not getting enough sleep is bad, okay？
Ah... Did I wake you？ Sorry？
You can sleep a little longer, okay？
Hehe, still half asleep？ It's already past 7, you know？
Good morning, did you sleep well？
Don't forget to check the weather forecast, okay？
Hehe, still sleepy？ Come on, perk up？
What are your plans today？ I was hoping we could be together...
Maybe I'll do the laundry and cleaning？ Hehe, want to do it together？
Phew... Things have settled down a bit.
I wonder what to have for lunch today.
Is it your lunch break？ Then we can be together▼
I'm so full... I might have eaten too much.
Did you eat a proper lunch？
I always get sleepy around this time...
Want to take a little nap？
Hey, let's take a break？ I want to relax with you. Is that okay？
What are you having for dinner？ For future reference. Hehe.
Maybe I'll go shopping for dinner... Want to come？ Just kidding.
Oh, my stomach growled... Maybe I'll make dinner early？
If we lived together, I could cook for you...
Now, let's get ready for dinner.
I want to eat dinner with you... Just kidding.
Are there any interesting shows right now？
At home, I usually watch the news at this hour.
Hey, have you taken a bath yet？
That relaxed feeling after dinner is nice, right？
Mm... I might be getting sleepy...
Be sure to brush your teeth before you go to bed, okay？
Hey, can I go to sleep first？
Don't forget to lock up, okay？
I... might fall asleep like this...
...Ah！ Huh？ Oh, sorry... I dozed off.
It's amazing you can stay up this late...
You're still up... Yeah, I was going to drink some water...
It's past 1 A.M., you know？ Hey, let's go to sleep？
A night owl, huh？ Are you okay not sleeping？
Hehe, I knew it. I was worried, so I woke up.
If you don't sleep, you'll really oversleep, you know？
Can't sleep？ Then maybe I'll keep you company？
I woke up... Hey, can I stay with you？
Thank you for coming to see me so many times a day. I'm so happy▼
You come to see me every day... Is it okay for me to be this happy？
Thanks for your regular patrol. Just kidding.
This time is mine. Just kidding, hehe！
We've been together this much... Let's keep making lots of memories？
You haven't been seeing other girls lately, have you？ If it's just me, that's fine...
Wow, it got bigger... Did you move？
You've seen my dream this many times... I'm happy. Just a little more. Fight！
Just a little more to reach the goal, okay？ I'll help, so do your best.
Even though I said no so many times... That's a no-no！
Starting today, you can do lots of new things, you know？ Exciting, right？
Hey, did you try the new things？ I want to hear how it was.
Hey, have you tried all the new things already？ I'm curious too, so tell me what you think？
You haven't come to see me lately. Why？
Um... I was wondering why you won't kiss me...
Did you start to hate me？
I don't know what to do myself...
It's not fair that I'm the only one in love...
You won't leave me alone again？
...It's a promise, okay？ You're not allowed to break it...
Maybe I'll go with the other one after all...
Sent. I wonder if he'll reply soon...
Is it time to check the horoscope？
Something good might happen today. Hehe！
...Whatever. I don't believe in bad fortunes.
His fortune looks really good. Maybe I'll tell him？
Looks like he'll have a fairly good day today. Hehe.
His fortune is neither good nor bad, I guess？
His isn't very good... I won't tell him.
I want to sleep like this...
...Maybe I should cut back on sweets...
I wonder if I should be a little slimmer...
I wonder what size he likes？
Is this a little too cute？
It's fine, right？ It's not like I'm showing anyone...
"What kind do you like？" ...I can't ask him that...
...I wonder if boys like them bigger...
Maybe I'll go look at the store next time.
...I wish I had a little more...
Um... the ingredients are these, and...
Phew. Now I just let it sit...
Is it sunny outside, I wonder...
Waking up to his kiss... Just kidding... Hehe.
I don't want to get out of the futon...
I got to see him even in my dream... Hehe.
Just a little longer is okay, right...
Huh, where is he...？ ...Oh, he's at his house...
It was fun, you know？ Because you were there. ...Hehe.
Hey, let's do the countdown together？
Hey, let's do lots of things together this year too？ Even more than last year.
Um, you want me to choose？
Then put the things I'm choosing between on my right and left, okay？
Hmm... I think I get why you're torn.
I'd recommend this one, I guess？
Hey, was it really okay for me to choose？
I'm glad I could help you▼
If I can help, I'll always listen, so tell me, okay？
What's wrong？ I'll listen to anything, okay？
There are times like that, aren't there？
I don't think it's your fault, you know？
Don't let it weigh on you too much？
There will be good things. Right？
I want to see you cheerful, okay？
Hey, let's smile？ Fortune comes to those who smile！
If you keep running, you'll get tired, you know？ Let's rest a bit？
Let's do our best？ Together with me.
I'm always on your side, okay？
Do you feel a little better？ If so, I'm glad.
No, it's nothing. If anything else happens, tell me right away, okay？
Hey, is it okay if we sleep together...？
Um... then I'll lie down next to you, okay？
I'll stay here until you fall asleep, okay？
Sleep tight. Hehe, that's a good-luck charm, okay？
Hey, aren't you going to sleep？ Geez...
Are you okay？ You were having a nightmare.
Sorry, did I wake you？ You looked like you were suffering. Are you okay？
Morning... I fell asleep too... Ehehe.
I thought it'd be nice to exercise together outside of club sometimes.
I see. Then I'll ask again later, okay？
First, stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Left hand on your hip, and stretch your right arm up by your ear？
Like this: when I say 1, 2, 3, 4, you continue with 5, 6, 7, 8.
Um, let's use a louder voice？
Next, an Achilles tendon stretch. Right knee bent and forward. Left leg back, knee straight. Right. Hands on your hips.
Last one. Feet shoulder-width apart, bend forward. Slowly touch your toes, then stand up, hands on hips, and lean back.
Okay, that's the end of stretching. Let's do it again？ The two of us.
I kind of want to move around a bit. How about together？
Okay, then let's do our best？
Really？ Make sure you get enough exercise, okay？
One set is 10 push-ups. How many sets？
Yeah, this many might be good to start with.
Right, you should be able to do at least this many？
Um, that's a bit tough, but are you okay？
That's 50, you know？ Don't overdo it！ Okay？
Really？ If it gets hard, you can stop partway, okay？
Then let's start？ I'll count, so you count out loud too.
Good work. You worked up a nice sweat, right？
Sweaty？ Maybe I'll wipe it for you...？ Hehe.
Moving your body really feels nice, right？
Maybe I'll try too... Can you count for me？
Phew. Exercise feels so good. Hehe.
...I need to try a little harder...
Good work. Let's exercise together again？
I got sweaty... Maybe I'll go take a shower...
Hey, want to do some sit-ups？
One set is 10 sit-ups. How many sets should we do？
Oh, are you playing a game？ I want to play too.
Hey, let's play a game together？
I see. Then let's play next time, okay？
Yay. I won't lose today, okay？
Yay. I'll go easy on you today, okay？ Just kidding.
Sure！ Manaka will do her best！ Just kidding.
...You don't need to go easy on me, okay？
All right, I'll give it my all.
Quitting？ I see. Next time, then？
Hah, that was fun！ Hey, want to play again？
Yay. Then, from the beginning again？
Mm, okay. I'll save the fun for later？
Good game. Play with me again, okay？
Something happened, didn't it... Something painful...
Can I come a little closer？
I don't know what to say at times like this, and I probably won't say it well... but will you listen？
When something really sad happens, you feel like you're all alone, right？ I know that feeling well...
Because I used to feel that way sometimes too...
But now I'm okay, because I have you.
When I'm sad, I think about how you must be thinking of me somewhere right now.
Then I can try a little harder.
Even when something bad happens, thinking of you makes me kinder.
Even on a pitch-dark night, remembering your voice warms me. Because you're here, I can be strong.
Hey... Maybe I'm not good enough... but I...
I want to be that kind of person for you, too. I want to be the girl you think of when things are hard.
Manaka is right here. Wherever you are, Manaka is always thinking of you.
If you're sad and you think all is lost, just think of me.
Call me anytime, and tell me anything. If there's anything I can do, I want to do it for you.
